nodes.label: Root Env File Contract
nodes.rationale: One root app env file per environment (development/test/staging/production) is the single source of truth for Compose interpolation, frontend build args, and backend runtime config; Compose has no application-value fallbacks.

nodes.label: APP_ENV
nodes.rationale: Backend runtime deployment environment; selects default server port (3002/3003/3004/3005) and Gin mode.

nodes.label: VITE_APP_ENV
nodes.rationale: Frontend-facing mirror of APP_ENV for browser-exposed environment-dependent behavior; should normally match APP_ENV.

nodes.label: Shared HTTPS Edge
nodes.rationale: A single Docker Caddy service owns public ports 80/443 for staging and production, routes by hostname over the timeful-edge network, and reads CADDY_* values from .env.edge; upstreams must match each stack APP_ENV port.

nodes.label: Test Isolation
nodes.rationale: Route tests and browser E2E use the isolated timeful-test Compose overlay with test-only volumes; E2E gets a fresh timeful-test-* PostgreSQL database per run and never targets development databases.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Roles and Migrations
nodes.rationale: Digest-pinned postgres:18.6-bookworm; separate bootstrap, migrator (Goose), least-privilege application, and reserved backup roles; one-shot postgres-migrate service gates server startup; forward-only migrations; backup automation deferred in phase one.

nodes.label: MongoDB Authentication
nodes.rationale: Development/test stacks run unauthenticated isolated instances; staging/production use separate root and application credentials with readWrite scoped to MONGODB_DATABASE; bootstrap script enables auth on existing volumes idempotently.

nodes.label: VITE_ENABLE_FREEMIUM
nodes.rationale: Frontend build-time flag controlling freemium operational gating; passed through Compose build args.
